_metadata.description: Configurable thresholds for the paid media waste audit engine
_metadata.notes: These are starting defaults based on automotive industry norms. Adjust per-client as needed.

zero_conversion_spend.description: Flag keywords/ads/campaigns with spend above threshold and zero conversions (form fills + calls + VDP leads) over the period.

low_vdp_to_lead.description: Flag campaigns driving VDP traffic with lead conversion below threshold. Higher threshold for domestic (lower consideration cycle).

high_spend_low_return.description: Flag campaigns in top 20% of spend but bottom 30% of attributable results.

search_term_bleed.description: Flag top non-automotive or irrelevant search terms consuming budget.

geo_waste.description: Flag spend outside primary market radius with no conversions. Radius adjustable per client.

device_hour_waste.description: Flag hours or devices with disproportionate spend-to-conversion ratios (3x+ the average ratio).

overall_waste_estimate.description: Industry benchmarks suggest 20-30% of paid media spend is typically wasted. Used for context framing, not as a target.
